opportunity.title: Short-Form Video Content Package for Small Businesses
opportunity.target_customer: Small businesses and content creators looking to enhance their social media presence on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
opportunity.customer_problem: Many small businesses struggle to create engaging short-form video content that resonates with their target audience, often lacking the time, expertise, or resources to develop effective video strategies.
opportunity.proposed_solution: Offer a comprehensive short-form video content package that includes scriptwriting, video editing, and strategic social media captions tailored to the client's brand and goals.
deliverables: Three customized video scripts per month.
Editing of three 30-second videos per month.
One month of social media strategy consulting.
Performance metrics analysis for each video.
opportunity.next_action: Create a service listing on a freelance platform.
